CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)

   B. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   D. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   D. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)

   B. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   D. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   D. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Natural Resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Functions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Divisions of the Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
